isolation: Private ROS domains 190/191 and private Zenoh; diagnostic costmap observers only, no semantic navigation influence.

resources.server: G1 unchanged: requests 3 CPU/12Gi, limits 6 CPU/24Gi, one GPU
resources.simulator: requests 3 CPU/3Gi, limits 6 CPU/8Gi, one GPU

background_load: Native RGB/depth bridge, camera compressor, TF/odometry/lidar and dual costmap observers active; additional bounded 0.5 CPU sidecar during each measured run. Existing unrelated cluster load retained and resource samples recorded.
preflight: Short diagnostic pilots may identify setup or performance issues. All attempts retained. No ten-minute run starts until pipeline and projection preflight pass.
retry_policy: No failed measurements erased. Configuration changes require new qualification runs; no threshold relaxation. Infrastructure failures are labeled, diagnosed, and retained.
geometry: Keep installed qualified semantic plugin; add observer-only odom fixed frame. Re-run installed plugin projection/clearing tests and real-world pause/reset/clear lifecycle; moving TF derives original odometry stamp, never arrival time.
